'''Buggles''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[voorpak]] owned by [[Torra Doza]], a resident of the ''[[Colossus]]'' platform on the [[planet]] [[Castilon]]. He remained close by his owner Torra's side though she normally kept him in her room. Buggles was involved in a few low stake adventures aboard the ''Colossus''. During the [[Battle of Castilon]], Buggles helped Torra find [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']] leader [[Kazuda Xiono]].

==Biography==
===Background===
Buggles was a pet [[voorpak]] owned by [[Torra Doza]], the teenage daughter of [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]], the administrator of the ''[[Colossus]]'' station.<ref name="Secrets and Holograms" /> In her free [[time]], Doza enjoyed playing and relaxing with Buggles.<ref name="WotG" /> [[BB-8]] once encountered Buggles loose in the [[Colossus marketplace|''Colossus'' marketplace]], and was followed by Buggles into [[Aunt Z's Tavern]]. Buggles subsequently nearly tripped up [[Lin Gaava]] while she was exiting her booth.<ref name="The Search for Kaz">{{Resistance|The Search for Kaz}}</ref>

===Torra's gilded cage===
Later Torra, annoyed at being confined to her [[Torra's Quarters|bedroom]] by her father, used Buggles to escape from the droid [[4D-M1N]] by giving him to her, explaining that he needed to be take out or else he would have another accident indoors. After 4D-M1N left, Torra slipped out of her bedroom as she had deduced the passcode, but her presence in the hallway was given away when Buggles saw her over 4D's shoulder and reacted. The droid was prevented from chasing after Torra, however, when Buggles then urinated on the floor. When Torra later returned to her room, accompanied by [[Kazuda Xiono]], Buggles was present while they played ''[[Flight Simulator Squadron]]''. After Xiono left [[Doza Tower]] after a series of events, Torra cuddled her pet while wondering what he was hiding.<ref name="Secrets and Holograms" />

===Running circles around Xiono===
Sometime later Torra asked Xiono to watch Buggles at [[Jarek Yeager's Repair Station]] while she was busy. However, the Voorpak escaped Xiono, first eating the contents of a bowl before running outside and hopping onto the precarious structures at the very edge of the platform, with Xiono in pursuit. He nearly managed to catch Buggles before the pet bounded off again, to his dismay. When Torra returned in search of Buggles, Xiono evaded her question of where he was. The voorpak had gotten into the cockpit of the ''[[Fireball]]'', and managed to launch the [[starship]] by randomly pressing buttons. Torra asked who was piloting the ship, and Xiono was forced to admit it was Buggles, to her horror.<ref name="Buggles Day Out">{{Resistance|Buggle's Day Out}}</ref>

===Torra's kidnapping===
Buggles was present when Torra brought her friends Kaz, [[Tamara Ryvora]], and the undercover pirate spy [[Synara San]] to her room for a game of [[Drone-Blaster]]. Later that night, Buggles was in Torra's room when the pirates [[Drell]] and [[Valik]] infiltrated the room and [[Torra Doza's abduction|kidnapped]] Torra. The First Order, who had engineered the kidnapping, later rescued Torra and used the incident to force Captain Doza to allow the First Order to [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupy]] the ''Colossus''.<ref name="Doza Dilemma">{{Resistance|The Doza Dilemma}}</ref>

===The First Order Occupation===
Buggles remained by her owner Torra's side during the First Order's occupation of the ''Colossus''. Buggles was sitting beside Torra when a group of [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] marched past Torra's quarters. One of these stormtroopers was an undercover Kaz who had stolen a [[data rod]] from the First Order containing intelligence on their fleet movements.<ref name="The New Trooper">{{Resistance|The New Trooper}}</ref>

When [[Neeku Vozo]], Kaz, [[Jarek Yeager]], and the [[Chelidae]] sank the ''Colossus'' in order to disable the First Order's jammer and [[Mission to contact the Resistance|contact]] the [[Resistance]], Torra scurried to her quarters with Buggles.<ref name="Descent">{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}}</ref>

===Liberation of the ''Colossus''===
After [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] arrested Captain Doza, Torra sent Buggles on a mission to find Xiono in the ''Colossus''. Buggles found Kaz and the [[BB-series astromech droid]] [[CB-23]] and led them to the trapdoor where Torra was hiding. After fighting off the First Order BB series droid [[MB-13A]], Torra, Kaz, and CB-23 embarked on a mission to free Yeager, Captain Doza, and Tam Ryvora.<ref name="No Escape Part 1">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 1}}</ref>

===Stowaway===
During the [[Mission to Celsor 3|mission]] to [[Celsor 3]], Buggles stowed away on the ''Fireball'', much to Kazuda's frustration. During the skirmish with the [[jakoosk]], Buggles ran off, causing Torra to run after him. After the jakoosk was taken down by Kaz, Buggles reappeared, climbing on top of the jakoosk before being picked up by Torra.<ref name="Hunt on Celsor 3">{{Resistance|Hunt on Celsor 3}}</ref>

===Victory===
Following the [[Battle of Barabesh|rescue of Tamara Ryvora]], Buggles joined several Colossus residents including [[Z'Vk'Thkrkza|Aunt Z]], [[Bolza Grool]], [[Opeepit]], [[Garma]], [[Mika Grey]], [[Kel]], [[Eila]], and [[Grevel]] in celebrating the defeat of the First Order forces that had been [[Hunt for the Colossus|pursuing]] them.<ref name="The Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Buggles was a [[Gender|male]] Voorpak<ref name="Databank" /> with [[Color|tan]] fur and blue eyes. Buggles was playful, a little mischievous, and had a close bond with his master Torra Doza. He also took a liking to Torra's friend Kazuda Xiono, and would often jump on him and lick his face much to his chagrin.<ref name="WotG" /> He was intelligent enough to find Kaz and bring him to her during the Escape of the ''Colossus''.<ref name="No Escape Part 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Buggles was first mentioned in the [[2018]] book ''[[Star Wars: Women of the Galaxy]]'', which was written by [[Amy Ratcliffe]].<ref name="WotG" /> Buggles first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' episode "[[Secrets and Holograms]]," which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2018]]. Buggles' design was based on concept art developed by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Bucket's list Ep9">{{BucketsList|llMI5G8X6U4|#1.10: "Secrets and Holograms"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-secrets-and-holograms-star-wars-resistance}}</ref> The title of the short "[[Buggle's Day Out]]," in which he plays a prominent role, misspells his name in the process of misplacing an apostrophe.<ref name="Buggles Day Out" />
